### Requirements
- [ComfyUI-PlagueKind-Nodes](https://github.com/PlagueKind/Comfyui-PlagueKind-Nodes)
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [Rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)
- [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)
- [ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod
](https://github.com/Luisacaotica/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod)
- [ComfyUI_PowerShiftScheduler
](https://github.com/silveroxides/ComfyUI_PowerShiftScheduler)


---

### Diffusion Model

RTX 5090 production profile: 10Eros Max beta7 fix1 activation-learned HQ.

[10Eros Max beta7 fix1 activation-learned HQ for RTX 5090](https://huggingface.co/LokkenJP/TenEros_Max_optimized_learned/resolve/5bb5da8183916c380bad115cefd190ccfd139598/10Eros_Max_h3_8stepTURBO_beta7_fix1_activation_learned_HQ.safetensors)

### VAE

Audio VAE for refmod creation.

[minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/4b53a35191437de05370da548e59aeabe2a5a09a/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

Encode VAE for refmod use.

[minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/c2e7b89b1800123c49a0f620a1932c01d8952256/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)

Decode VAE or Encode without refmod.

[p-h3-image_vae_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy/resolve/1bf3b0cee1bc1ff45408d0af7a246ae594fbdf74/vae/p-h3-image_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)

Preview VAE

[vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/resolve/bcec7bc2b0e0a277bd0d5c028605590de711bfb6/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors)

### Text Encoder 

[qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_native_w4g128_w6protected_15.35gb](https://huggingface.co/LokkenJP/TenEros_Max_optimized_learned/resolve/5bb5da8183916c380bad115cefd190ccfd139598/text_encoder/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_native_w4g128_w6protected_15.35gb.safetensors)

### Edit lora

[p-h3-image_lora_bf16](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/P-H3-Image-Comfy/resolve/1bf3b0cee1bc1ff45408d0af7a246ae594fbdf74/loras/p-h3-image_lora_bf16.safetensors)


---
### V1 Notes

- For refmod use, lynnreal is required in the encoder slot, if only using pictures you can use the other. P-h3 must always be in decode.


- Disable the image node with the bypasser or remove your images for T2I.


- I kept the sparse node, not for the speed but for the ref enforcement option.


- This bundled production workflow uses an 8-step Eros beta7 fix1 model and replaces PreviewImage with SaveImage.


- Create refmods in the subgraph.


- Added lynnreal light vae, I didn't add sol vae because it was too soft.


- This 8-step Turbo profile is configured for 8 steps.

- Best use between 4-8MP


- Overall function is similar to my Video WF, so you'll probably feel at home.
